descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens through collaboration. As a global leader in measurement instruments, our more than 17,000 employees shape the future of process automation. Whether innovating and implementing new technologies as a team, collaborating on the development of new devices, or strengthening key relationships with various global industries, our work is built on creating trusted connections that lead to success for everyone. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term goals and work toward a forward-thinking vision for our employees, our customers, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Technical Lead Embedded C++ Software Developer to join our team and use your experience to sustainably shape our software landscape—both technically and personally.

What is this role about?

Are you someone who enjoys taking bold technological steps? Do you like turning ideas into clear software concepts for the future? And do you find joy in guiding others on their journey and setting standards together?

If this sounds like you, you can expect a role where you help shape our future device generations and have a real impact on technologies that people around the world encounter every day.

Your responsibilities

You will:

• take on functional and technical software leadership within the context of our current and future software platforms.

• design new software concepts, system architectures, and processes within the software environment as part of a team, laying the foundation for upcoming device generations.

• shape strategic development within software, establish processes and new methods, and continuously improve them.

• support the professional development of employees through active coaching and mentoring.

• play a key role in building and maintaining networks inside and outside the company and represent our interests in standardization organizations.

What we expect from you

You:

• hold a university degree (Master, Doctor of Technical Sciences ETH or equivalent) in Technical Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Automation Technology.

• have at least 15 years of experience in development, architecture, and real-time design of embedded systems.

• possess excellent knowledge and experience in Embedded C/C++, safety and robustness methods, software quality metrics, and test-driven development.

• bring solid knowledge from an industrial environment and are familiar with requirements in regulated application areas such as functional safety or metrology.

• have experience in corporate and committee work as well as excellent English skills and at least good German skills.

What you can expect from us

• We are a family-owned company with strong commitment and a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and development opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We invest in your health with a comprehensive health management program.

• We support you with a company pension plan and initiatives to balance family and work.

• You benefit from a work environment where technological curiosity, appreciation, and creative freedom come together.

How to apply

Please upload your application documents on our career page. Unfortunately, applications sent by email cannot be considered for data protection reasons.

Agencies, personnel service providers, or similar companies are kindly asked not to send unsolicited profiles or inquiries regarding potential collaboration. We are currently not working with external service providers for this position. All unsolicited applications from service providers will not be considered and will be deleted without further review. Thank you for your understanding.

#LI-NZ1

titleByLocale.it: Servizi di Costruzione/Costruzione per Acquirenti Strategici 80-100% (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 17,000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Strategic Buyer Construction / Construction Services 80-100% (f/m/d) to join our team and further develop our global procurement activities while strategically managing complex construction projects.

What is the role about?

Are you interested in managing complex procurement projects in a construction environment? Do you enjoy actively developing and shaping supplier strategies? Would you like to make a direct impact on competitiveness through your analyses and negotiations?
Then this role offers you a versatile opportunity with a high degree of autonomy, where you actively shape procurement strategies.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

• develop and implement procurement strategies for construction services, focusing on cost optimization and risk management.

• manage the procurement of strategic investment projects, including new builds, conversions and refurbishments.

• oversee the end-to-end procurement process, from demand identification to invoice verification, including negotiations and contract management.

• act as a key point of contact for procurement topics across our global production sites.

• develop and manage the supplier portfolio and evaluate suppliers based on performance, quality and reliability.

• collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders and actively support site planning activities.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• hold a bachelor’s degree in business administration, construction, facility management or a comparable qualification, ideally with further training in procurement.

• bring at least 5 years of experience in procurement, preferably in construction services and project management in an international environment.

• have solid knowledge of RFI/RFP processes and the investment environment (CapEx); knowledge of SIA standards is an advantage.

• work in an analytical and structured manner and are able to manage multiple projects in parallel.

• communicate confidently and negotiate effectively in German and English; French is a plus.

• act independently and proactively and maintain an overview even under time pressure.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-owned, highly committed company with a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.

• We offer an internationally oriented working environment with a high degree of creative freedom.

• We prioritize Work-Life Balance, offering flexible working hours and remote work opportunities.

• We ensure modern working conditions and attractive employment terms.

How do you apply?

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations.

Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

Chez Endress+ Hauser, le progrès se produit en travaillant ensemble. Leader mondial de l'instrumentation de mesure, plus de 17 000 employés façonnent l'avenir dans le domaine de l'automatisation des processus. Qu'il s'agisse de développer et de réaliser de nouvelles technologies en équipe, de collaborer à la construction d'instruments ou de renforcer les relations vitales avec d'innombrables industries mondiales, nous travaillons à créer des relations de confiance qui aident chacun à prospérer. En tant qu'entreprise familiale, nous regardons au-delà des mouvements à court terme et travaillons pour créer une vision qui est prospective pour nos gens, nos clients et le monde en général. Nous recherchons un Acheteur Stratégique Construction / Construction Services 80-100% (f/m/j) pour rejoindre notre équipe et développer davantage nos activités d'approvisionnement mondial tout en gérant stratégiquement des projets de construction complexes. Quel est le rôle? Êtes-vous intéressé à gérer des projets d'approvisionnement complexes dans un environnement de construction? Vous aimez développer et façonner activement les stratégies des fournisseurs? Souhaitez-vous avoir un impact direct sur la compétitivité par vos analyses et vos négociations? Ensuite, ce rôle vous offre une opportunité polyvalente avec un haut degré d'autonomie, où vous façonnez activement les stratégies d'approvisionnement. Quelles tâches exécuterez-vous? Vous:
• élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'approvisionnement pour les services de construction, en mettant l'accent sur l'optimisation des coûts et la gestion des risques.
• gérer l'acquisition de projets d'investissement stratégiques, y compris les nouveaux bâtiments, les conversions et les rénovations.
• superviser le processus d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, de l'identification de la demande à la vérification des factures, y compris les négociations et la gestion des marchés.
• agir comme un point de contact clé pour les sujets d'approvisionnement dans nos sites de production mondiaux.
• développer et gérer le portefeuille de fournisseurs et évaluer les fournisseurs en fonction des performances, de la qualité et de la fiabilité.
• collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes et externes et appuyer activement les activités de planification du site. Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? Vous :
• Être titulaire d'un baccalauréat en administration des affaires, construction, gestion des installations ou d'une qualification comparable, idéalement avec une formation continue en approvisionnement.
• apporter au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans les achats, de préférence dans les services de construction et la gestion de projets dans un environnement international.
• posséder une bonne connaissance des processus de RFI/RFP et de l'environnement d'investissement (CapEx); la connaissance des normes SIA est un avantage.
• travailler de manière analytique et structurée et être capable de gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.
• communiquer avec confiance et négocier efficacement en allemand et en anglais; le français est un plus.
• agir de manière indépendante et proactive et maintenir un aperçu même sous pression temporelle. Qu'attendez-vous de nous ?
• Nous sommes une entreprise familiale très engagée avec une vision durable.
• Nous encourageons l'éducation et la formation tout au long de la vie grâce à une formation polyvalente et à des possibilités de formation continue, au transfert interne de connaissances et à l'apprentissage en ligne.
• Nous offrons un environnement de travail orienté internationalement avec un haut degré de liberté créative.
• Nous privilégions l'équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle, offrant des horaires de travail flexibles et des possibilités de travail à distance.
• Nous garantissons des conditions de travail modernes et des conditions d'emploi attrayantes. Comment postuler ? Pour postuler, nous vous prions de bien vouloir télécharger vos documents sur notre page carrière. Les demandes qui nous sont envoyées par e-mail ne peuvent malheureusement pas être considérées en raison de considérations de confidentialité des données. Les organismes, les fournisseurs de services de RH ou des entités similaires sont priés de s'abstenir de soumettre sans invitation des profils et des demandes de renseignements concernant une collaboration éventuelle. Actuellement, nous n'intervenons pas avec des fournisseurs de services externes pour ce rôle. Toute demande non sollicitée sera ignorée et supprimée sans autre considération. Nous apprécions votre compréhension. Postuler maintenant »
